answer_1.quote: Controlling response length in large language models (LLMs) is critical for efficient deployment... This work establishes extreme value theory as a principled framework for modeling LLM verbosity patterns in question-answering tasks across architectures.

answer_2.quote: Model selection via maximum likelihood estimation used both Akaike information criterion (AIC) and root-mean-square error (RMSE)... achieving unprecedented tail fit accuracy (R 2 CDF = 0.9993).
